title: A series of [2 × 2] square grid LnIII clusters: a large magnetocaloric effect and single-molecule-magnet behavior

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred solution of H3L (0.025 mmol) in methanol (20 mL) was added Gd(acac)3·2H2O (0.025 mmol) in dichloromethane (5 mL). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 30 min, then heated under reflux for 12 h to afford a light yellow solution, cooled to room temperature, filtered, and left unperturbed for slow evaporation. After about one week, crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained (yield 45% based on Gd).
synthesis.time: stirred 30 min; reflux 12 h; crystallization about 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvent volatilization / slow evaporation after reflux
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered, and left unperturbed for slow evaporation at room temperature; crystals after about one week

properties.summary: Weak antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd coupling (J = −0.022 cm−1, g = 2.03). Large magnetocaloric effect with −ΔSm = 34.46 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.0 K and ΔH = 7.0 T. Magnetization saturates at 28.02 Nβ.

properties.summary: χMT decreases from 47.84 to 29.93 cm3 K mol−1 (300–2.0 K). No out-of-phase ac signals under zero dc field (not an SMM). Solid-state TbIII luminescence at room temperature (λex = 285 nm) with dual-exponential lifetimes 9.51 and 50.92 ms.
